name: Applitus no Enkan
source:
[i]Lose your mind, wander, take what's not yours, and commit the ultimate sin—all in the name of a single love.[/i]

A young man enveloped in mystery suddenly appears in the heart of Tokyo amidst an unusually warm climate. Two beautiful girls, contrasting yet supportive, come to aid the weakened young man who has lost his memories. Unbeknownst to them, their love and tears are all part of a cursed cycle...

[Translated and edited from the official [url=https://twitter.com/nekopara_pr/status/1161253510291177477/]Nekopara Twitter's account[/url]]
translation:
[i]失去理智，徘徊，拿走不属于你的东西，并犯下最终的罪恶——这一切都以单一的爱的名义。[/i]

一个充满神秘色彩的年轻人突然出现在气候异常温暖的东京市中心。两个美丽的女孩，对比鲜明但相互支持，前来帮助失去记忆的虚弱年轻人。他们不知道的是，他们的爱和泪水都是一个被诅咒的循环的一部分……
